title: A bill to amend the Farm Security and Rural Investment Act of 2002 to extend terminal lakes assistance.
official_summary: This act extends through October 1, 2025, authority to provide terminal lakes assistance.

summary.headline: A January 2023 law extends the federal government's authority to provide terminal lakes assistance through October 1, 2025.
summary.what_it_does: This act amends the Farm Security and Rural Investment Act of 2002 to keep in place the authority to provide terminal lakes assistance. The extension runs through October 1, 2025. The official summary does not describe what the assistance covers, how payments or aid are made, or who qualifies.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 5, 2023. The assistance authority is extended through October 1, 2025.
